en.title: Your Warmth Upon the Blank Score
en.premise: Kaito is a boy born without musical talent—the source of magic in this world—and unable to see the "colors" of existence. In a forbidden underground library at the city's lowest depths, he meets Lila, a girl who spends her days composing "songs of silence" that no one can hear. In a society that prizes only functional music, the two begin to play a dissonance—imperfect, yet poignant enough to touch the soul. It was a melody called love, pure enough to repaint the world.

zh.title: 在空白的乐谱上，留下你的体温
zh.premise: 少年凯特没有音乐才能（魔力），无法看见世界的“颜色”。在城市最底层的禁忌地下图书馆中，他遇见了少女莉拉，她一直在书写着无人能听见的“静寂之曲”。在这个只赞美功能性音乐的城市里，两人开始奏响不完美、却足以触动心弦的不协和音。那是名为“恋爱”的旋律，纯粹到足以将整个世界重新涂抹。
